newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire Pacific 1996 net up 18.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swire Pacific 1996 net up 18.6 pct.

text.p: Earnings per A shr (H.K. cents) 482.8 vs 407.0
Earnings per B shr (H.K. cents) 96.6 vs 81.4
NOTE - Swire Pacific is a general trading house with interests in aviaton, property, shipping and offshore services industries, trading and insurance.

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$1.05 billion from the sale of an 80 percent interest in a subsidiary which holds the JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong, a gain of HK$468 million from the sale of an effective 10.65 percent in the direct interest in Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd and HK$59 million profit from the transfer of business from Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Co Ltd to a joint venture company formed with Rolls-Royce Plc.
Total dividend for year per 'A' share is 177 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of 43 cents) vs 159 cents and per 'B' share is 35.4 cents (including interim dividend of 8.6 cents) vs 31.8 cents.
